properties.description: Two CLI entry points (train and export_bundle) both following the same pattern: argparse -> load_experiment_config -> bootstrap_project_paths -> call engine function. Both invoked via python -m from shell scripts.

End-to-end training pipeline: CLI -> config -> dataloader (Pi05LeRobotDataset + normalizers) -> model (build_pi05_with_lora) -> optimizer/scheduler -> Accelerate prepare -> train loop -> checkpoint -> final adapter -> deploy bundle export.

Training dataset extracts chunk_size-length action sequences (default 30). The chunk is padded at episode boundaries by repeating the last valid action. This is the train-side counterpart of the deploy-side chunked prediction.

The official PI0.5 preprocessor expects: observation.state (B, state_dim), action (B, chunk_size, action_dim), observation.images.<camera> (B, C, H, W), task (list[str]). The to_lerobot_pi05_batch adapter maps local keys to this schema.

Pi05LoraTrainer optionally auto-launches TensorBoard via launch_tensorboard() which: (1) checks for existing TensorBoard on the same logdir to reuse, (2) detects port conflicts and finds alternatives, (3) falls back from tensorboard binary to python -m tensorboard.main.

Pi05LoraTrainer.run() calls log_run_summary() on main process
Pi05LoraTrainer._train_loop() calls to_lerobot_pi05_batch(batch) to adapt local batch keys for the PI0.5 preprocessor
Pi05LoraTrainer._train_loop() calls export_final_adapter() after all epochs
Pi05LoraTrainer._train_loop() calls _maybe_export_deploy_bundle() after final adapter export
Pi05LoraTrainer._init_trackers() calls launch_tensorboard() on main process when tensorboard_auto_launch is set
Pi05LoraTrainer._maybe_export_deploy_bundle() calls export_deploy_bundle() to create deploy artifact
build_train_dataloader() creates Pi05LeRobotDataset twice: first to bootstrap normalizers, then with normalizers applied
Pi05LeRobotDataset wraps LeRobotDataset internally (self.lerobot_dataset), using it for metadata and data access
dataset.py imports ColorJitter and InterpolationMode from torchvision.transforms
builders.py imports DataConfig, TrainingConfig from pi05.common.config.schema
trainer.py imports build_pi05_with_lora, get_pi05_policy_config from pi05.common.model.builder
trainer.py imports builder functions from pi05.train.engine.builders
trainer.py imports checkpoint functions from pi05.train.engine.checkpoints
trainer.py imports configure_logging, log_run_summary from pi05.train.utils.logging
The CLI interface concept is realized by the pi05.train package
Pi05LoraTrainer is the central orchestrator of the training pipeline
The training pipeline uses Pi05LeRobotDataset for data loading
Action chunking is implemented by _get_action_chunk() method
The batch schema adapter is implemented by to_lerobot_pi05_batch()
TensorBoard auto-launch is implemented by launch_tensorboard() in pi05.train.utils.tensorboard
TensorBoard launch is triggered by Pi05LoraTrainer._init_trackers() when use_tensorboard and tensorboard_auto_launch are set
Pi05LeRobotDataset.__getitem__() produces items that are then adapted by to_lerobot_pi05_batch() into the batch schema
Pi05LoraTrainer._build_accelerator() creates Accelerator with gradient accumulation, mixed precision, and TensorBoard config
build_optimizer() creates AdamW optimizer from torch.optim
__init__ calls _resolve_image_keys() to build image key mapping
__init__ calls _validate_vector_features() to check state/action dim consistency
__init__ calls _build_episode_ranges() for action chunk boundary clamping
_prepare_image calls _to_image_tensor() to convert input to float32 CHW tensor
_resolve_task calls _task_from_index() when task_index is present but task is not
Pi05LoraTrainer.run() calls _train_loop() as the final training step
Pi05LoraTrainer.run() calls make_pi05_pre_post_processors(policy_config) to create the preprocessor
